name: Apprentice of Aspects
body:
You have delved into the heart of nature herself.

Prerequisite(s): Skill Focus (Knowledge [nature]), Wis 13, character level 4th.

Benefit(s): Select one minor aspect for which you meet all the prerequisites. You permanently gain access to the chosen minor aspect. You have an effective animist level equal to half your character level, rounded down, for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of minor aspects, as well as for the purpose of determining how many times you can use that minor aspect per day.
